TOOLING BURST T0-d1 — lane/audit fixes + check_sync (SPEC § 6 row "T0-d lane extensions", items (a) (b) (d) (f: F-1, F-2) and `lane/check_sync.py`; the T0-d1 half of conductor ruling R-3). task_id "T0-d1".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0 constraints, § 2 (the T0-a lane contract you are amending), § 6 the "T0-d lane extensions" row (your contract; read (a)–(f) and the Split clause).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. the existing astra_test_01/burst/lane/ and tests/ (test_audit.py, test_run_burst.py, test_lane.py, test_ledger.py, test_schema_check.py, fixtures/*.jsonl, run_t0c.py) — amend in place; do not rewrite what works.
4. EVIDENCE (read-only, outside the repo): /Users/admin/astra-burst/runs/C-1/X1-gen-01/events.jsonl and out/receipt.json (a GENERATE burst: 2 image_gen calls, calls_used=2, yet the --json stream holds only two command_execution items — `cat …/skills/.system/imagegen/SKILL.md` and a `cp` from ~/.codex/generated_images/<thread_id>/…png); /Users/admin/astra-burst/runs/C-1/X1-chk-01/events.jsonl (5 false forbidden-tool hits: the regex ran over command text and matched the repo path 'reincarnated-collaboration'); /Users/admin/astra-burst/runs/C-1/T0-c/events.jsonl (7 more false hits, same cause). Directory listing of /Users/admin/.codex/generated_images/ (one subdir per thread_id; X1's thread 01a09380-5f48-7472-b6f4-ff30d17f12a9 holds exactly the 2 PNGs). /Users/admin/.codex/astra-burst.config.toml (the profile: `model = "gpt-6-astra"`, `model_reasoning_effort = "high"`).
5. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/canonical/reap-die-rise-game/painted-2d-pipeline/00-system.md — ONLY § 7 (the SYNC table check_sync must verify).
Do not read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, role files, the charter, oracles/, parts/, compare/, transcribe/, gates/, bible/, or anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy ONLY for this burst (no scipy needed).

BUILD (all under astra_test_01/burst/, via --add-dir):
A. lane/audit.py — forbidden-tool detection applies ONLY to the item's `type`, `tool`, `name`, `server` fields (lower-cased, word-boundary match on web|collaboration|spawn); NEVER to command text. Replaying the three evidence streams through the census must yield ZERO forbidden-tool violations; the existing tests/fixtures/bad_events.jsonl (a real `web__run` tool item) must still trip.
B. lane/audit.py + lane/run_burst.py — image-call truth source (F-1): before launch, run_burst lists $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/ (env CODEX_HOME, else ~/.codex) recursively (path → sha256 or size+mtime); after the burst, diff; restrict to the burst's thread_id subdir when `thread.started` carries one, else all subdirs. `image_calls` = the number of NEW image files (png/jpg/webp); each recorded in the audit dict as `generated_images_new[] {path, sha256}`. Keep the old event heuristic ONLY as `image_calls_events` (reported, never used for caps or the ledger). If a valid receipt exists and `receipt.calls_used != image_calls` → violation `image count mismatch (audit N vs receipt M)`. The ledger's `image_calls` and `images_used` come from the truth source. Document in the module docstring that the --json stream does not surface image_gen.
C. lane/audit.py — snapshot roots (F-2) = the workdir + the declared add_dirs ONLY (never the repo); exclude from the tree/diff: any `.git/` directory, `__pycache__/`, `*.pyc`, and the wrapper's own `out/.wrapper-events.jsonl` / `out/.wrapper-stderr.txt`. Workdir changes remain permitted only under out/. add_dir changes are permitted for TOOLING only.
D. lane/run_burst.py — validate_task: `effort` must equal "high" (reject any other value); non-TOOLING tasks must declare `add_dirs: []` (reject otherwise). verify_files (SPEC (b)): for TOOLING, receipt-listed files may live under a declared add_dir (absolute, or relative to the add_dir); verify them IN PLACE (exists, sha256 matches, no symlink, no traversal) and record them as `artifacts_in_place[] {root: <add_dir>, name: <path relative to root>, sha256}` in the ledger entry — do not copy them; for every other type the under-out/ rule is unchanged. Nothing under out/ of a TOOLING burst is required.
E. lane/run_burst.py + lane/ledger.py — every ledger entry gains: `model` (parsed from ~/.codex/astra-burst.config.toml `model`; the --json stream does not echo the model — say so in a field `model_source: "profile"`), `effort` (the task's), `codex_version` (`codex --version` stdout, stripped), `profile_sha256` (sha256 of the profile file), `artifacts_in_place`, `image_calls_events`, `generated_images_new`. ledger.append must accept these fields (keep its existing validation: duplicate id, non-negative int image_calls, atomic replace under the lock).
F. lane/check_sync.py — CLI: parse § 7 of /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/canonical/reap-die-rise-game/painted-2d-pipeline/00-system.md (the markdown table rows `| \`<path>\` | … | <sha256[:12]> | <date> |`; a row's first cell may carry a trailing parenthetical after the backticked path — take the backticked path only); resolve `~`; resolve relative paths against the repo root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]; compute sha256[:12]; print one line per row `OK|DRIFT <stamped> <actual> <path>`; `--json` emits a list; `--doc <path>` overrides the doc (for tests); exit 0 iff every row is OK, 1 on any DRIFT or unreadable source, 2 on a parse failure. Never modify the doc.
G. tests — amend tests/test_audit.py, test_run_burst.py, test_lane.py, test_ledger.py; add tests/test_check_sync.py (a synthetic doc + temp sources under tests/tmp/: all-OK → 0; one stale row → 1; unreadable source → 1; a source path with a parenthetical after the backticks parses). Add REAL fixtures by copying the three evidence streams to tests/fixtures/x1_gen_01_events.jsonl, x1_chk_01_events.jsonl, t0c_events.jsonl and assert zero forbidden-tool violations on each; assert a synthetic item {"type":"mcp_tool_call","server":"web","tool":"run"} and {"type":"custom_tool_call","name":"web__run"} DO trip; assert a command_execution whose command text is "cat /x/reincarnated-collaboration/web/spawn.py" does NOT. Test the generated_images diff with a temp CODEX_HOME (env override) holding a pre-existing file and one new file → image_calls == 1 and the new file recorded; test the receipt mismatch violation; test that a non-high effort and a non-TOOLING add_dirs are rejected; test artifacts_in_place verification (hash match / mismatch / symlink). Every test must be able to fail on a bad input.
H. Then run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py`. Expected: exactly the two pre-existing named-red cases (tests/test_oracles_motif.py::test_f04_outside_at_least_three and tests/test_compare.py::test_stub_rejects_f04_crop — they belong to T0-d2, do not touch them) and everything else green. Report the exact counts. If anything else is red, fix your own regressions only.

DO NOT touch: oracles/, parts/, compare/, transcribe/, gates/, bible/, fixtures/ (except tests/fixtures/), SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, receipt.schema.json, MANIFEST.sha256, runs/ (conductor-owned), briefs/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under astra_test_01/burst/tests/tmp/ (create; clean). Never the system temp dir.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T0-d1"): "files" = every created/modified file with its sha256 (absolute paths under astra_test_01/burst are correct — the wrapper auditing THIS burst is the pre-fix one and will VOID the burst on exactly the defects you are fixing; that is expected and recorded by the conductor); "images": []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name precisely anything you could not make pass, with its number. Never PASS/FAIL.
